{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}')"}
